title: Decider step-cost archaeology — relocate End-of-Run sweep + queue-management prose to conditionally-loaded reference modules to shrink the priority-step cached prefix. (DIRECTIVE-20260628-003, Candidate B + Candidate-F appendix)
why_human_needed: Relocating correctness-critical End-of-Run prose (A0c chain-aware close has ISS-1285/PROP-070 bug history; Step B is the curmudgeon-queue single-writer) introduces a 'forgot to Read the module' failure mode. Operator must approve the unmissable-pointer mitigation and pick which diff(s) to ship.
do_not_auto_close_reason: propose-only + requires_human_judgment; no mechanical FIXED check until operator selects a diff and ships it.
summary: PROP-112 step-cost data (14 decider runs + 8 integrity runs, all claude-sonnet-4-6) shows decider's cost is concentrated in two stable buckets: priority-4-completed-expansions ($1.89 mean/occ, $24.59 total, 13/14 runs) and end-of-run-B-queue-mgmt ($0.74 mean/occ, $8.17 total, 11/14). Both are 65-72% cache_read. Root cause is structural: decider.md (1377 lines / ~23K tok) carries ~17.4K tokens of End-of-Run procedure (Steps A0/A0b/A0c/A/A0d/B, L469-1324) in the cached prefix during EVERY message of the expensive priority steps, even though none of it is needed until the priority step finishes. Relocating ~10.8K tokens of that prose (the A0+A0b+A0c sweep block and Step B) into conditionally-loaded reference modules — mirroring the decider's existing decider-patches-and-selfapply.md / decider-reporting.md Read-at-end pattern and PROP-111 1C — shrinks the priority-step prefix by ~10.8K tok, saving ~$0.20/decider-run (~4%). Integrity's top bucket (check-9-build-reproducibility, $0.56) is NOT a prompt-slim candidate: its prose is ~250 tok; its cost is the build+HTML-diff tool-results. Flagged honestly per directive constraint.
the_correction_up_front: The cost is in the PREFIX SIZE during high-message-count steps, not in the per-step prose itself. priority-4's prose can't be slimmed (it IS the work). What CAN be slimmed is everything that sits in priority-4's 34-message prefix but isn't needed yet — the End-of-Run procedure. That is why the slim targets End-of-Run sections to reduce the cost of the PRIORITY steps.

sample_size_confidence_interval.directive_requirement: PROP-116 flagged the ~13/7-row sample as small; report must state stability explicitly.
sample_size_confidence_interval.finding: Top-2 ranking is STABLE; #3 is outlier-sensitive.
sample_size_confidence_interval.evidence: Split the 14 decider runs into first-7 / last-7 and rank steps by total cost in each half. Both halves AND the all-14 aggregate put priority-4-completed-expansions at #1 and end-of-run-B-queue-mgmt at #2. The #3 slot rotates (priority-1-new-wins first half, priority-5b-m1-stale-sweep second half, priority-5-standard overall) — outlier-driven by which rare priority fired. priority-4 was the single most-expensive step in 9/14 individual runs. priority-4 per-occ cost ranges $0.04-$3.96 (mean 1.89, median 2.00) — high variance from expansion-integration volume, but rank-1 aggregate position is robust.
sample_size_confidence_interval.implication: Diffs 1+2 target the two STABLE top buckets — safe to act on now. Any #3-targeted slim should wait for >=20-25 rows.

diffs.combined_effect: Diffs 1+2 relocate ~10,776 tokens. decider.md shrinks from 1377 to ~700 lines. The relocated prose enters the prefix only when its reference module is Read (at end-of-run), so the priority steps (priority-4 = 34 msgs, priority-5, priority-1) and the early end-of-run steps no longer carry it.

savings_projection.model: cache_read price (Sonnet) = $0.30/MTok. Saving per run = (tokens relocated) x (messages occurring BEFORE the reference module is Read) x $0.30/M, minus a one-time cache_write of the relocated tokens when the module is Read (roughly offset by the now-smaller agent-prompt cache_write).
savings_projection.per_run_estimate: Relocated ~10.8K tok; ~75-80 of a typical ~99-message decider run occur before End-of-Run. Saving ~= 10,776 x 78 x $0.30/M ~= $0.25/run gross, ~$0.19-0.24 net. Call it ~$0.20/decider-run, ~4% of the $5.20 mean.
savings_projection.annualized: Quiet cadence (1 decider run/day): ~$6/mo, ~$73/yr. Active cadence (3 runs/day): ~$18/mo, ~$219/yr.
savings_projection.why_it_compounds: The saving scales with BOTH run frequency and messages-per-run. Active periods raise both (3x cadence + fuller priority-4/Step-B buckets as expansion + queue volume rises), so the saving is largest exactly when cost pressure returns — the highest-confidence forward-value framing from PROP-116.

the_other_side_arguments: AGAINST: ~$0.20/run (~$73-219/yr) is small; the dominant pipeline cost is the Opus agents (analyst, curmudgeon, tinker) which have NO PROP-112 data, so this optimizes a Sonnet agent that may not be the real bottleneck. Counter: it is the highest-confidence DATA-GROUNDED slim available, low-risk (extends an existing pattern), and compounds in active periods.

AGAINST: relocating A0c (chain-aware close) and Step B (queue single-writer) risks a 'forgot to Read' silent failure of correctness-critical logic. Counter: the unmissable-pointer stubs mirror the already-working decider-patches-and-selfapply.md / decider-reporting.md pattern that has not produced skip failures; integrity check-7e digest-coverage + the A0c fail-loud self-test would catch a dropped sweep. Still the load-bearing risk and WHY this PROP is requires_human_judgment.

AGAINST: a smaller decider.md means 2 extra Read tool-calls per run, each adding a round-trip + tool_result. Counter: the reference-module content is identical tokens, just deferred; the extra Read latency is negligible vs the cache_read saving on 78 messages.

AGAINST: doing nothing — data may shift once active period returns and priority-4 message counts change. Counter: top-2 rank is stable across both run-halves; waiting only forfeits the active-period compounding.

cost_burn_projection_appendix_candidate_.bottleneck_identification: Within the instrumented two, decider is ~84% of active-period cost and priority-4 + Step B are ~60% of decider's cost — exactly the buckets Diffs 1+2 slim. Honest limitation: cannot quantify them without PROP-112 instrumentation on Opus agents — a recommended next measurement (PROP-101/112 Phase 2 already plans Opus self-cost rows).
